title: Conversions API (CAPI) & EMQ
objectives: Explain why browser-based pixels leak up to 30% of conversion data
Understand the role of the Conversions API (CAPI) and Events Manager
Learn Event Match Quality (EMQ) and event deduplication

blocks.text: In the modern web, browser ad-blockers and privacy updates block regular pixels. CAPI is the bulletproof solution!
The Conversions API (CAPI) creates a direct server-to-server connection between your website hosting server and Meta's servers.

left.title: Browser Pixel Only
points: Easily blocked by ad-blockers and iOS

right.title: Conversions API (CAPI)
points: Runs securely on your web server
Cannot be blocked by client ad-blockers

blocks.title: The Postman vs Private Courier
blocks.text: The browser pixel is like sending a postcard through a rainy street: it might get lost in the storm. CAPI is like a secure pneumatic tube connecting your cash register straight to Meta!

blocks.title: How Deduplication Works
items: 1. User buys a saree on your website
3. Server CAPI fires 'Purchase' with identical event_id: 'ORDER_101'
4. Meta sees matching event_id and records exactly ONE conversion!

blocks.text: Event Match Quality (EMQ) scores from 0-10. Sending customer email and phone number (+91) with server events raises your EMQ to 8.0+.

quiz.q: What is the primary technical advantage of Conversions API (CAPI) over standard browser pixels?
options: It makes Facebook ads 100% free of charge
It operates server-to-server, bypassing browser ad-blockers and privacy restrictions
It generates free video ads automatically
quiz.explain: Because CAPI communicates server-to-server, client-side browser blockers cannot intercept the conversion data.

quiz.q: What parameter is required to prevent Meta from double-counting conversions when both Pixel and CAPI fire?
quiz.explain: Passing identical event_id parameters allows Meta's servers to deduplicate the two signals into a single event.

quiz.q: What does an Event Match Quality (EMQ) score of 8.5/10 indicate in Events Manager?
options: The ad account is about to be suspended
Excellent match rate: customer parameters like email and phone match active Meta profiles accurately
The website is loading too slowly
quiz.explain: A high EMQ score indicates Meta can easily match the conversion to the specific user account who saw the ad.

quiz.q: True or False: Using both the Meta Pixel and CAPI simultaneously is officially recommended by Meta.
quiz.explain: True! The redundant setup ensures maximum signal coverage and resilient attribution.

recap: CAPI connects your website server directly to Meta, overcoming browser signal loss.
Pass event_id to deduplicate signals and aim for EMQ scores above 8.0.
